title: 第1196章 突破失败第1195章 鏖战十祖
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
然后。
炸了。
轰隆隆——
毁天灭地的大爆炸。
金紫色的冲击波横扫了整个诸天战场。
方圆数百万里的虚空都被这次爆炸撕成了碎片。
空间碎片如同破碎的镜子般四处飞溅。
时间乱流在虚空中疯狂肆虐，有些地方时间在倒流，有些地方时间在加速，有些地方时间干脆停住了。
因果线被炸得七零八落，无数因果纠缠在了一起又分开，分开了又纠缠在一起。
诸天战场这个存在了无数纪元的古老战场，被陆尘这一击炸出了一个永久性的空洞。
空洞之中什么都不存在。
没有空间，没有时间，没有因果，没有大道。
只有虚无。
真正的虚无。
十大界主被冲击波轰得四散横飞。
太初神帝身前的金色光盾轰然破碎，他整个人狂喷着鲜血向后倒飞。
鲜血中夹杂着内脏碎片。
永恒圣主更惨，他的永恒屏障根本没有撑过一个呼吸的时间就被炸开了。
冲击波结结实实地轰在他胸口，胸骨塌陷下去一大片。
每一根肋骨都断了三截以上。

轮回葬主的六道轮回漩涡被炸得彻底崩碎，六道轮回通道全都在反噬之力下断裂。
他的枯骨身躯上布满了裂纹，鬼火双眸忽明忽灭。
荒兽之主的九颗头颅有三颗直接被炸碎，另外六颗也全都在流血。
他庞大的身躯在虚空中翻滚着，压碎了无数空间碎片。
太古龙皇的始祖龙魂被炸得虚幻了几分，他本人更是被震得七窍流血。
龙血洒在虚空中，每一滴都重若万钧。
太阳神帝的大日之躯被炸出了几百个窟窿，金色的太阳真火从窟窿中喷涌而出。
他疼得脸都扭曲了。
缥缈仙帝的仙剑阵还没完全展开就被炸碎，剑阵反噬让他神魂受到了重创。
杀戮剑主最倒霉，他所化的杀戮之剑正好处在爆炸的最中心。
剑身上直接被炸出了一道裂痕。
这道裂痕至少要温养上百个纪元才能恢复。
万妖祖神的万妖盾牌同样没有撑住，被冲击波撕成了碎片。
他周身妖气被炸散了大半，露出了那张妖异的面孔。
此刻面孔上写满了惊骇。
十大界主之中，唯一还能勉强稳住身形的，只有死亡至尊。
但他也被震得在虚空中连退了十几步。
每一步踩下去，都会在虚空中踩出一个漆黑的空间裂缝。
content_en:
Then.
Exploded.
Rumble——
A huge explosion that destroyed the world.
The golden-purple shock wave swept across the entire battlefield.
The void for millions of miles around was torn to pieces by this explosion.
Space debris flew everywhere like broken mirrors.
The turbulence of time is raging crazily in the void. In some places, time is flowing backwards, in some places, time is accelerating, and in some places, time has simply stopped.
The lines of cause and effect were blown to pieces, and countless causes and effects were entangled together and separated, separated and entangled again.
The battlefield of the heavens, an ancient battlefield that had existed for countless epochs, was blasted with a permanent hole by Lu Chen's blow.
Nothing exists in the void.
There is no space, no time, no cause and effect, no avenue.
There is only nothingness.
True nothingness.
The ten world masters were blown away by the shock wave.
The golden light shield in front of the Taichu God Emperor shattered suddenly, and he flew backwards, spurting out blood.
The blood was mixed with pieces of internal organs.
The Eternal Holy Lord was even worse. His eternal barrier didn't even last a single breath before it was blown apart.
The shock wave hit his chest firmly, and his sternum collapsed to a large extent.
Each rib was broken at least three times.
The six reincarnation whirlpools of the Samsara Burial Master were blown to pieces, and all six reincarnation passages were broken by the force of the backlash.
His skeletal body was covered with cracks, and his will-o'-the-wisp eyes flickered on and off.
Three of the nine heads of the Lord of Wild Beasts were directly blown to pieces, and the other six were all bleeding.
His huge body rolled in the void, crushing countless space fragments.
The ancestral dragon soul of the Ancient Dragon King was blown to pieces, and he himself was even shocked to the point of bleeding from all his orifices.
The dragon's blood is sprinkled in the void, and every drop is as heavy as a thousand stones.
Hundreds of holes were blown out of the body of the Sun God Emperor, and the golden true fire of the sun spurted out from the holes.
His face was twisted in pain.
Immortal Emperor Piao Miao's immortal sword array was blown to pieces before it was fully deployed, and the backlash from the sword array caused severe damage to his soul.
The Killing Sword Master was the most unlucky, as the Killing Sword he transformed was right at the center of the explosion.
A crack was directly blown out of the sword.
This crack will take at least hundreds of epochs to heal.
The Ten Thousand Demons Shield of the Ten Thousand Demons Ancestral God also failed to hold up and was torn into pieces by the shock wave.
Most of the demonic energy around him was blown away, revealing that demonic face.
The face was full of horror at this moment.
Among the ten world masters, the only one who can barely maintain his figure is Death Supreme.
But he was also shocked and took more than ten steps back in the void.
Every step he takes will create a dark space crack in the void.
